name: Pyke
notes: Opens with Death from Below (R) at t=0: its 0.5s cast holds attacks, then it deals the non-execute physical damage; the dummy's health is assumed to never fall under the level-scaling execute threshold in an 8-15s single-target fight, so the raw execute damage and its free recast never trigger and the fixed 50%-style physical formula (base + 40% bonus AD + 0.75 per Lethality) is used every time.

Bone Skewer (Q) is quick-released rather than fully charged, since extra charge time only extends range, which is irrelevant against a stationary adjacent dummy: the press has the wiki's 0.25s cast time (busy_until holds off any other cast or attack for it), and the release then follows 0.4s later per the wiki's stated minimum quick-release time (the bin's MinChargeTime=0.5 is treated as stale). Its cooldown starts at the release, matching the wiki's post-effect cdstart for Q.

Phantom Undertow (E) is cast on cooldown with no cast time; its damage and stun land automatically 1s later when the phantom returns. Its cooldown is started at cast, since no post-effect cdstart is documented for E (unlike Q and R, which explicitly state one).
Ghostwater Dive (W) is never cast: it deals no damage, and its camouflage and decaying move speed have no effect in a stationary, no-mobility fight, so casting it would only waste time and mana.

Gift of the Drowned Ones converts Pyke's bonus health into bonus attack damage (1 AD per 14 bonus health, i.e. 7.143% of bonus health); this is folded in as a flat AD steroid on attacks and added to Q/E/R's bonus-AD ratios. Its grey-health storage/heal mechanic is purely defensive and has no effect on damage dealt, so it is ignored.
Basic attacks fill all remaining time between casts; Pyke has no on-hit rider or attack reset.

Lethality's scaling on Q's slow duration, W's move speed and E's stun duration is utility/duration only and is ignored; only the bonus-AD and per-Lethality damage ratios on R (and the AD ratios on Q/E) feed into damage.
Mana costs (Q 70-90, E 40, R 100) are not modeled: nothing here binds inside a 15s fight at level 16.
